crop_image_depth_and_intrinsic_by_pp: crop an image and depth map around the camera principal point, adjusting the intrinsic matrix accordingly
resize_image_depth_and_intrinsic: resize an image and depth map to a target shape while updating the camera intrinsic matrix and track coordinates
depth_to_world_coords_points: convert a depth map to world coordinates given camera extrinsic and intrinsic matrices
rotate_90_degrees: rotate an image, depth map, and camera parameters by 90 degrees clockwise or counterclockwise
read_depth: read a depth map from disk in .exr or 16-bit PNG format and return a float32 array
